Subject: Post-discovery: orchestration request — choose priority bands and attendees

Hi Samir / Laura —

Thanks again for the conversation just now. Quick recap and a proposed way forward so we can lock the next session (30-minute product intro + Q&A):

TL;DR: aim to run a focused 30-minute demo for product and infra stakeholders. Please confirm one of the bands below and who from your team should join. Once you confirm we’ll send a calendar invite and a short prep note.

Recap (1–2 lines):
- Your primary goals: validate inference latency/cost assumptions for batch inference and confirm data handling (retain/forwarding) in the Private deployment.
- Success criteria for the next meeting: high-level architecture alignment and an ops/infra checklist to decide whether to pilot.

Proposed bands (please pick the band that works and, if possible, one backup):
A) Week of Nov 17 — morning US PT windows (08:30–11:30 PT)
B) Week of Nov 17 — mid-afternoon US PT (13:00–16:00 PT)
C) Week of Nov 24 — flexible (we can accommodate later in the week)

Ask from you:
1) Which band works best (A/B/C) and a preferred day/time inside that band (two options if possible).
2) Who should join from your side (we suggest: CTO or Head of Platform, Security lead, and one Product owner).

Internal attendees from our side: Alex (product), Priyom (solutions/infra), Vanessa (CS).

Attachments: post-discovery-notes.pdf (call notes + checklist we covered), proposed-demo-outline.pptx (30-min running order).

If helpful I can also propose two concrete slots after I hear which band you prefer.

Thanks — short replies are great here.

—Alex Martinez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
---
Redwood Inference, Inc.
Attachments: post-discovery-notes.pdf (6 pages), proposed-demo-outline.pptx (8 slides)
